name: vieclus
reference: Biedermann, Henzinger, Schulz & Schuster. Memetic Graph Clustering. SEA 2018. (KaHIP/VieClus CLI, commit 0e27f24, MPI island parallelism)

leiden.doc: Use VieClus's Leiden mode, which guarantees connected communities. Off by default (standard memetic VieClus); an algorithm variant, not a tuned knob; set-only.

leiden_theta.doc: Leiden refinement temperature, only meaningful with --leiden. VieClus default 0.01; set-only. VieClus optimises plain modularity with no resolution parameter, so its only quality lever is the time budget (--time): Protocol A and B coincide. Parallelism is exposed via --threads (mpirun -n) and time-of-best via time_to_best_seconds in the report.
